headline: Colonials Take Callahan's Post; Wardens Regain One on Fisherman's Row
war_summary: Since our last edition the biggest news comes from Callahan's Passage, where the Colonials have carried a post, the count there reading nine Warden stations to one Colonial after a night in which The Latch alone accounted for twenty-one base events. The fight shows no sign of slackening: twelve more in the past two hours, with losses running near six hundred and nine hundred the hour. The Weathered Expanse swung back the other way, the Colonial tally slipping from seven to six with one station in ruins, as Frostmarch, Wightwalk, and Crow's Nest traded blows at a cost of better than twenty-three hundred Colonial and thirty-six hundred Warden casualties in two hours. Fisherman's Row, lately swept by the Colonials, now reads eight posts to a single Warden holding. The Stlican Shelf stands unaltered at five-four despite forty-one events, Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost accounting for every one. The Nevish Line has seen no flag move in ten hours yet keeps its terrible ledger, while Mooring County, quiet since early evening, sends its casualty rolls climbing at a suddenly sharper rate, and the Linn of Mercy exacts some two hundred Warden casualties the hour anew near Lathair. It is day 419 of the war; thirty-four victory towns decide it, and no victor is named.
